headline: Indonesia Becomes a Target for Data Center Investment, ESI Warns About Electricity and Clean Energy
summary: Energy Shift Institute Managing Director Putra Adhiguna said Indonesia is a promising data center destination, supported by incentives and reliable power. He warned about electricity supply and clean energy.
why: Data centers are large electricity consumers, so their growth ties investment in technology infrastructure to power supply and energy transition policy.
